dict.string: Aide uses the camera when you take a photo to send, like a meal to log.
Aide reads your sleep, heart rate, HRV, steps and workouts to write your wake-up briefing and tick off workout habits.
With Always, tram alerts know the walk to the stop with the app closed. Aide sends your location only when you move about 500 m or an alert is about to fire.
Aide sends where you are to your server, so a tram alert knows how long the walk to the stop is.
Aide listens when you tap the microphone, so you can talk instead of type.
Aide mirrors your reminders into a list in Apple Reminders so your phone can notify you.
Aide turns what you say into text to send to your assistant.
